why: There are three kinds of stripes: rising slant, flat, and falling slant. Each row uses each kind once. Row 3 has flat and falling stripes, so the missing triangle has rising stripes (lines going up to the right). That is option 2. Option 3 has falling stripes, which are already in row 3.
trick: Each row and column contains each shading type once - like a Sudoku.
